newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ticks up $1, US gives little support.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ticks up $1, US gives little support.

text.p: NWE gasoline gained about $1/2 a tonne on Tuesday morning but U.S. demand was fair and did not provide the support some dealers had forecast.
"The demand is in the U.S. Gulf not east coast, so it's better for the Caribs and Venezuela rather than Europe," said one dealer.
Unleaded premium grade gasoline barges were hovering around $186 fob.
Moving European gasoline transatlantic was possible if the party had the right grade and tonnage at a reasonable rate.
